name: Paing Soe Khant
bio: Year 3 ESD student at SUTD (Business Analytics & Operations Research), on a one-year entrepreneurship programme at KTH Stockholm, and Machine Learning Intern at Cager.ai. Turns messy operational data into tools people actually use: forecasting pipelines, live dashboards, and data bots for factories, banks and kitchens.

projects.title: UOB ATM Cash Replenishment System
projects.detail: End-to-end ML pipeline automating daily cash replenishment for 350 ATMs across Singapore. Hybrid ensemble of Holt-Winters, XGBoost and Prophet with dynamic model selection driven by real-time error monitoring, plus an interactive dashboard with Overview, 7-Day Schedule and Location Profiles tabs.

projects.title: Keystone Data Analysis Bot
projects.detail: LLM assistant built with Python, LangChain and OpenRouter that lets Keystone Cable staff query sensitive production data and Excel files in natural language, returning text answers and generated graphs.

projects.title: Keystone Operator Compliance Log & Dashboard
projects.detail: Node-RED and PostgreSQL system logging operator start and finish times and machine usage, feeding a Power BI dashboard of compliant vs non-compliant workers against the schedule (SOP compliance visibility).

projects.title: Keystone MQTT Broker Restructure
projects.detail: Restructured the factory's MQTT broker, optimising message payloads and topics for cleaner, more reliable live production-floor data and better live data visualisation.

projects.title: CBS Peer Performance Dashboard
projects.detail: Interactive Tableau dashboard letting CBS subscriber banks benchmark their credit portfolio performance against anonymised peer data.

projects.title: Cayenne's Inventory Management System
projects.detail: Pareto analysis of 3 months of sales (13 of 105 items made up 80% of sales) set stock priorities; built a real-time inventory dashboard shared across all 3 kitchens that auto-deducts stock on orders and updates on deliveries.

projects.title: FlowFinder, What The Hack 2025 Winner
projects.detail: Best Hack, 1st place in Clean Water & Sanitation. GPS-enabled device measuring water turbidity with an open-source map for logging and tracking water points in rural, water-scarce areas. Built from scratch in 2 days; drove the technical direction and gave the final presentation.

projects.title: NUS Maritime Hackathon 2026, Top 10%
projects.detail: Team Minorites, Category A. Used optimisation algorithms to maximise Singapore to Australia shipment profitability, narrowing 108 candidate vessels down to 22.

projects.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge 2025
projects.detail: Team lead for a 12-page equity research report on iFAST Corporation. Sourced from annual reports, quarterly earnings releases and Bloomberg, including forensic findings for the investment recommendation.

projects.title: Cager.ai, Machine Learning Intern
projects.detail: Researching ML approaches to detect misuse by autonomous AI agents, and mapped Cager's end-to-end detection pipeline together with the CEO.

projects.title: Solar-Powered Insect Trap
projects.detail: Rebuilt a battery-run insect trap as a solar-powered version that never needs charging. Designed the casing in Autodesk Inventor and 3D printed it, fitting every component with clean wiring.
